bull_case: Commerce, fintech, credit, ads and logistics keep compounding across Latin America, while current margin pressure normalizes. Owner FCF/share rises sharply as scale improves.
bear_case: Credit losses, free-shipping subsidies and logistics investment persist while FX and competition compress margins. Revenue grows but owner FCF/share remains weak.
thesis: At $1,825.21, MELI is close to the locked Base DCF of about $1,979. The business can justify the current price with sustained ecosystem growth and eventual FCF normalization, but there is little conventional margin of safety. H1 2026 revenue grew 49% while operating margin fell to 6.8% and adjusted FCF was only $158M. Valuation is supported by long-run reinvestment success rather than current cash yield.

evidence.claim: Frozen 2026-09-17 close is $1,825.21 and frozen market cap is about $92.53B.
evidence.source: StockAnalysis / Investing.com historical price and uploaded Q2 10-Q share count

evidence.claim: FY2025 adjusted free cash flow was $1.481B versus $1.215B in 2024.
H1 2026 revenue rose 49.4%, but operating margin fell to 6.8% and adjusted FCF fell to $158M from $512M.
GMV rose 43% and TPV 53% in H1, showing strong underlying activity despite lower profitability.
Locked Bear/Base/Bull values are about $138/$1,979/$4,720; price/Base is about 0.922x.

counterevidence: Base value is heavily terminal-dependent and assumes owner FCF/share recovers from depressed 2026 levels.
The H1 adjusted-FCF decline shows revenue growth does not automatically translate into discretionary cash.
Credit expansion raises provisioning, funding and tail-risk requirements.
Latin American FX and sovereign macro volatility can materially alter USD outcomes.
unknowns: Normalized adjusted FCF after the current credit/logistics investment wave.
Steady-state credit loss ratio and risk-adjusted ROIC.
Long-run commerce take rate and shipping economics.
Five-year valuation percentile on a consistent metric.

uncertainties.rationale: Current price needs strong long-duration execution but not a Bull-plus case.
Base upside is only modest at the frozen price.
Base value is sensitive to terminal FCF and margin recovery.

falsifiers: Adjusted FCF/share fails to recover despite continued GMV/TPV growth.
Credit losses and logistics subsidies keep operating margins structurally below the Base path.
A realistic Bull owner-FCF/share path no longer values the shares above market.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price is below Base and far below Bull; a Bull-plus outcome is not required.

key_kpis.name: Adjusted FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Recover and compound materially from 2026 trough levels

key_kpis.name: Operating margin
key_kpis.threshold: Recover without sacrificing GMV/TPV share gains

subscores.rationale: Current price requires durable compounding and margin recovery, but not an extreme Bull case.
Base value is only modestly above current price.
Terminal value and normalized FCF assumptions materially drive valuation.
